column1: # Catalogue of quality-gate checks: CR-43 design.md section 10, kept equal to it by tests/quality-gate/run.sh.
# status: `present` = scripts/checks/<id>.sh exists in this repository, and `quality-gate.sh --list` must show exactly
#         these rows with exactly these classes; `planned` = to be added here by a later CR-43 PR;
#         `template` = lives in the template repository only (no script here).
# `operator-contract` is one row: the platform version here; the template's generic version has the same id there.
# Not listed: the CI-only jobs of section 10 (template jobs, platform profile jobs); they are not gate checks.
# The test compares `quality-gate.sh --list` with the `present` rows only; the match of this file with design
# section 10 is checked by review, so change a row here only together with that section.
